title: Send a chat message and receive a streamed AI response
description: Verifies a user can send a message and see the AI response stream and then appear in the conversation.

steps.description: Verify element "message input field" is visible
Type "Hello Gemini, give me a one-sentence fun fact about space." into "message input field"
Verify text "Hello Gemini, give me a one-sentence fun fact about space." is visible
Verify element "AI response streaming indicator" is visible
Verify element "AI assistant message" is visible

title: Send two consecutive messages and confirm both AI replies are appended in order
description: Verifies multiple send cycles work and the conversation shows both user messages and corresponding AI replies.

steps.description: Verify element "AI assistant message" is visible
Type "Now give the result as a word only." into "message input field"
Verify text "Now give the result as a word only." is visible

title: Empty message validation prevents sending
description: Verifies clicking Send with an empty input shows the validation error and does not add a new user message bubble.

steps.description: Verify element "message input field" is visible
Verify text "Please enter a message" is visible
Verify element "AI response streaming indicator" is not visible
Verify element "new user message in conversation" is not visible

title: Retry after send failure successfully produces an AI response
description: Verifies the error state "Message failed to send" can be recovered via Retry and results in a streamed AI reply.

steps.description: Type "Tell me a short joke." into "message input field"
Verify text "Message failed to send" is visible
Verify element "AI response streaming indicator" is visible
Verify element "AI assistant message" is visible

title: Message input is cleared after sending
description: Verifies that after clicking Send, the input field is cleared (ready for the next message).

steps.description: Type "Summarize photosynthesis in 5 words." into "message input field"
Verify text "Summarize photosynthesis in 5 words." is visible
Verify element "AI response streaming indicator" is visible
Verify element "message input field" is visible
Verify text "Summarize photosynthesis in 5 words." is not visible in "message input field"

title: Long message can be sent and response appears
description: Verifies a longer user prompt can be submitted and the conversation still renders the user message and an AI response.

steps.description: Type "Write a concise checklist for planning a weekend trip, including packing, transport, budget, and safety." into "message input field"
Verify text "Write a concise checklist for planning a weekend trip, including packing, transport, budget, and safety." is visible
Verify element "AI response streaming indicator" is visible
Verify element "AI assistant message" is visible

title: Sending via Enter key triggers message send (if supported)
description: Verifies that pressing Enter in the message input sends the message and starts the AI streaming response.

steps.description: Type "Give me one tip for better sleep." into "message input field"
Verify text "Give me one tip for better sleep." is visible
Verify element "AI response streaming indicator" is visible
Verify element "AI assistant message" is visible

title: Save a new valid API key from Settings (API tab)
description: Verifies a user can add an API key and successfully save settings with a visible success notification.

title: Reject an invalid API key with validation error
description: Verifies an invalid API key entry shows a visible validation error and does not show success messaging.

steps.description: Verify text "Invalid API key" is visible
Verify text "Settings saved" is not visible

title: Save API settings with empty API key field shows required validation
description: Verifies saving with an empty API key input shows a visible validation message.

title: Change theme in General tab and confirm UI updates after save
description: Verifies changing the theme setting updates the visible UI after saving.

title: Switch theme back to Light and confirm UI updates after save
description: Verifies switching the theme back to Light persists via save and is visible in the UI.

title: Modify AI behavior settings and save successfully
description: Verifies AI behavior settings can be changed and saved with a visible success notification.

steps.description: Modify an AI behavior setting (for example, change a dropdown or toggle)
Verify the modified AI behavior setting value is visible

title: Switch between Settings tabs without losing visibility of the Save action
description: Verifies the user can move across API, General, and AI tabs and still see the Save control available.

title: Show environment error when screen capture is unavailable
description: Verifies the app shows a clear error and guidance when screen capture cannot run in the current environment.

steps.description: Verify text "Screen capture unavailable in current environment" is visible

title: Confirm crop without selecting an area (validation/guard behavior)
description: Verifies the user cannot confirm a crop until an area is selected (or sees a clear prompt if they try).

steps.description: Verify text "Select an area" is visible
Verify no image preview is visible in the message composer
